evidence: Tasks are displayed in priority order: 3 High-priority tasks first, then 1 Medium, then 1 Low.
Tasks sorted by deadline: Tomorrow, Aug 26, Aug 29, Aug 31, Sep 7. Earliest deadlines first as expected.

issue: Edit button is completely disabled for blocked tasks
actual: The edit button for blocked tasks (e.g., "Complete tax filing" blocked by "Review project proposal") is disabled with pointer-events-none, preventing any editing. The requirement specifies that description and priority should be editable even when blocked.

evidence: Created task "Test Task" with non-empty title. Active count increased from 5 to 6. Task appears in active list with Medium priority.

Created "Complete Report" task with title, description, deadline (Sep 1), priority (High), and prerequisite (Test Task). All details retained and displayed. Task shows blocking status with prerequisite warning.

issue: Update functionality does not persist changes despite success notification
actual: Deletion works correctly: "Test Task" was deleted, active count decreased from 7 to 6, task removed from list. However, when editing "Buy groceries" description and saving, a "Task updated" notification appeared but the description in the task list did not change. Reopening the task shows the original description still stored.

evidence: Successfully marked "Complete Report" as completed. Active count decreased from 6 to 5, completed count increased from 2 to 3. Task removed from active view.
Successfully switched between Active (showing 5 tasks) and Completed (showing 3 tasks) views. Each view displays only tasks in corresponding state. Counts are accurate and update correctly.
Successfully assigned 2 prerequisites ("Review project proposal" and "Schedule dentist appointment") to "Buy groceries". Task saved and retained the prerequisite dependencies in the database.
Task "Buy groceries" with incomplete prerequisites now shows disabled complete button, visually distinguishing it as blocked. The blocking is applied despite the task being an active task.
Blocked task "Buy groceries" displays prominent warning "2 prerequisites incomplete". Warning appears next to the task, clearly identifying the number of incomplete prerequisites.
Empty title field keeps "Create Task" button disabled. Whitespace-only title also keeps button disabled. Both cases prevent task creation.

Tasks with incomplete prerequisites have disabled complete buttons. "Buy groceries" with 2 incomplete prerequisites shows disabled completion button, preventing completion until prerequisites are met.

Task "Complete Report" was completed, moved to completed view, and remained available for later access. Task count went from 5 active to 3 completed (from 2 completed), showing it was moved not deleted. Reopening completed view showed the task with all details intact.

Task "Buy groceries" depends on "Review project proposal". When editing "Review project proposal", "Buy groceries" is not available as a prerequisite option in the prerequisites list, preventing the creation of a circular dependency.

Tasks display all components: titles, priorities (High/Medium/Low icons), descriptions when provided, deadlines when provided, and prerequisite blocking warnings when applicable. Completed tasks are visibly distinct in separate view from active tasks.

Hovering over "2 prerequisites incomplete" warning displays a tooltip showing "Dependency Chain" with list of pending prerequisites: "Review project proposal" and "Schedule dentist appointment", each marked as "pending".
Task "Complete Report" was reopened from completed state and returned to active view with enabled complete button and no prerequisite warnings. System maintains valid task states during transitions.

5 dashed visual connection lines with class "stroke-primary" found on page, indicating visual connections are implemented. Tooltip infrastructure verified through IX-20 (prerequisite warning hover shows dependency chain). SVG hover testing limited by Playwright accessibility constraints, but implementation is present.
